blocks.text: Sun Life of Canada (Philippines), Inc. (Sunlife) has been recognized with a Golden Arrow Award for the eighth consecutive year, based on the 2025 ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS). The recognition reflects Sunlife’s sustained commitment to strong corporate governance and responsible business practices. More importantly, it reinforces the standards that help Sunlife protect its Clients’ interests, make sound decisions, manage risks responsibly, and remain accountable to the people it serves. The recognition ceremony was held recently at the Makati Shangri-La in Makati City, with Sunlife Philippines’ Country Head and CEO, JJ Moreno, and General Counsel, Atty.
